personas.name: Paloma Cocktail Crafters
personas.bioLifestyleNeeds: Home mixologist and social entertainer who refuses to make a Paloma with anything other than authentic Squirt soda and 100% agave tequila.
personas.nba: Offer cross-promotional coupons pairing Squirt 12-packs with premium tequila and fresh limes
personas.coreValues: Authenticity, hospitality, and craft beverage quality
personas.imagePrompt: Realistic portrait of a stylish Hispanic man in his late 20s smiling in a bright modern kitchen with fresh citrus and a cocktail shaker.

details.name: Mateo Rodriguez
details.bio: Weekends at my place mean fresh tacos on the plancha and handcrafted Palomas. Squirt is the undisputed king of grapefruit sodas—nothing else has that real citrus tartness to balance good blanco tequila.
pain_points: Bars serving Palomas with grapefruit juice and simple syrup instead of authentic bubbly Squirt
Local stores running out of 12-pack cans before holiday weekends
goals: Master authentic Southwestern and Mexican cocktail recipes
Keep the home bar stocked with premium mixers and cold Squirt cans

personas.name: Zero Sugar Citrus Hydrators
personas.bioLifestyleNeeds: Fitness enthusiast and busy professional seeking bold, tart flavor without sugar, calories, or artificial syrup aftertaste.
personas.nba: Highlight Zero Sugar multi-pack pantry stocking discounts and chilled grab-and-go convenience
personas.coreValues: Health balance, vibrant energy, and crisp refreshment
personas.imagePrompt: Realistic portrait of a vibrant woman in her early 30s in activewear holding a chilled can of citrus soda outdoors.

details.name: Sarah Jenkins
details.bio: I switched away from sugary sodas years ago, but most diet drinks taste flat or artificial. Squirt Zero Sugar keeps that sharp, punchy grapefruit bite that actually satisfies afternoon thirst without ruining my workout goals.
pain_points: Limited shelf space for zero-sugar citrus varieties in some grocery stores
Afternoon caffeine jitters from standard energy drinks
goals: Stay hydrated and refreshed during long workdays without sugar crashes
Find zero-calorie sodas with genuine tart fruit flavor

personas.name: Southwest Taco & BBQ Grillmasters
personas.bioLifestyleNeeds: Passionate weekend griller and family gathering organizer who always pairs grilled meats and spicy salsas with ice-cold Squirt.
personas.nba: Offer family cookout bundle savings pairing Squirt 2-liters and 12-packs with grilling staples
personas.coreValues: Family tradition, culinary passion, and generous hospitality
personas.imagePrompt: Realistic portrait of a warm Hispanic father in his 40s wearing a grill apron standing by an outdoor patio grill.

details.name: Carlos Ramirez
details.bio: In our family, you cannot have carne asada or carnitas without ice-cold Squirt on the table. That crisp grapefruit flavor cuts through the rich spices and smoky grill flavor like nothing else. It has been a family tradition since I was a kid.
preferred_products: Carne Asada Marinades & Street Taco Fixings
pain_points: Running out of cans during large Sunday family dinners
Small store formats lacking multi-pack case savings
goals: Host memorable family gatherings with delicious homemade food and favorite beverages
Ensure the pantry is always stocked with cold drinks everyone loves

context: Squirt is an iconic naturally flavored grapefruit and citrus soda brand owned by Keurig Dr Pepper. Renowned for its crisp, tart, and wildly refreshing flavor, caffeine-free recipe, and heritage as the essential authentic mixer for Mexican Palomas.
audienceTargets: Citrus soda drinkers, craft Paloma mixologists, Zero-sugar wellness consumers, and Southwestern family cookout shoppers
